question: Which five tattvas, and how is each all-power-full?
premises: named Shiva Shakti Sa Desha Avidya: five tattvas
in each one also, in this tattva
inference: The pentad pervades each member with all powers.
plain_english: Named Shiva Shakti Sa Desha Avidya: five tattvas — in each one also, in this tattva, full of all powers.
